summary: Completed E2E testing of ENZI Batch C iteration 197: Live Stripe Payment Gateway and Advanced Behavioral Modeling. All 24 backend tests passed (100%). All 15 frontend UI tests passed (100%). Stripe checkout creates real sessions via emergentintegrations library. Behavioral modeling returns context-aware triggers, smart suggestions, and usage insights with engagement scores.
critical_code_review_comments: enzi_payments.py: Uses emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout for real Stripe sessions. Creates checkout URL, stores transaction in payment_transactions collection.
enzi_payments.py: GET /api/lumi/payments/packages returns 4 packages (pro_monthly $9.99, pro_yearly $99.99, team_monthly $29.99, enterprise $99.99).
enzi_payments.py: GET /api/lumi/payments/status/{session_id} polls Stripe status, updates user premium flag on successful payment.

behavioral.py: GET /api/lumi/behavior/context-triggers checks unread_overload (>10 unread), inactive_channels (3+ days), morning_routine (8-10am), end_of_day (4-6pm), scheduled_messages (due in 2hrs).
behavioral.py: GET /api/lumi/behavior/smart-suggestions analyzes message patterns (questions->suggest bot), meeting mentions, unusual hours (wellbeing tip), E2EE status.
behavioral.py: GET /api/lumi/behavior/usage-insights returns weekly stats: messages_sent, active_channels, meetings_attended, peak_hours, engagement_score (0-100).
PremiumModal.jsx: Displays 4 package cards with pricing, features list, and Upgrade buttons. Uses TIER_STYLES for gradient backgrounds.
InsightsPanel.jsx: Shows usage stats grid (Messages/Channels/Meetings), engagement score, context triggers with priority colors, smart suggestions with action buttons.
